description: This file defines the SQSAdapter class, which implements the IQueueAdapter interface for integrating Amazon SQS with Orleans streaming. It manages message queuing, serialization, and stream-to-queue mapping.

classes.name: SQSAdapter
classes.description: Implements an Orleans stream queue adapter for Amazon SQS, handling message serialization, queue management, and stream-to-queue mapping.

methods.name: SQSAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SQSAdapter with serializer, queue mapper, logger factory, connection string, service ID, and provider name.

methods.name: CreateReceiver
methods.description: Creates and returns an SQS adapter receiver for a specific queue ID.

methods.name: QueueMessageBatchAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously enqueues a batch of messages onto the appropriate SQS queue, with support for stream ID, events, and request context.
